title: Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing
function: Control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this nuclear hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for control rod drive application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for control rod drive performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing suitable for Control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring?
faq.a: Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address nuclear hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for control rod drive requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. control rod drive components require Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for control rod drive application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet control rod drive specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for CRDM seal / Rod housing nuclear hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
